integrity: Original mathematical proof is contained in RESULT.md; source papers are cited but not reproduced. No independent scientific or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determines the exact Minkowski asymmetry and one canonical minimizing center for \(p,q\ge2\). Does not determine the full center locus or extend to arbitrary bipartite graphs. Finite computations are checks, not the infinite proof. Equivalence to an earlier calculation under different terminology remains a literature risk.
title: Balanced anomaly in the Minkowski asymmetry of complete-bipartite spanning-tree polytopes
